flags.text: "Add inline citation badges anchored to matching answer text, with source details available on hover or keyboard focus." - PR #233 initially added this, but PR #244 removed that implementation when integrating Markdown rendering and deferred inline badges. PR #245 later reintroduced them over sanitized Markdown. Presented as a separate addition alongside #245, this misstates what shipped.

"the first actionable suggestion appears in the header as a button or assignee picker" - The first step becomes the primary control, but when no suggestion is actionable it falls back to a caption. The facts do not say every ticket with suggestions has an actionable first step.

"After knowledge-base passages are retrieved, the assistant runs a grounding check before streaming its answer unless it has already checked during that run." - The loop forces a check once after passages appear if none has run. A check earlier in the run does not establish that the newly retrieved passages were checked; the facts explicitly do not guarantee coverage of every passage in a longer chain.

"Completion claims are tied to successful tool results in the conversation" - The PR added a system-prompt instruction not to claim a change succeeded without a successful tool result. The facts do not establish a mechanism that guarantees the assistant always follows that instruction.
